title: Kissed Indulgent Canadian Bacon Braise
description: A rich and indulgent Canadian dish featuring tender bacon and a flavorful braise, crafted with ayurvedic-rajasic-friendly ingredients to delight the senses.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large Dutch oven, cook the Canadian bacon over medium heat until browned, then set aside.
Add the chopped onion to the pot and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped carrots and potatoes to the pot, cooking for an additional 5 minutes.
Add the beef broth, brown sugar, thyme, and pepper to the pot, stirring to combine.
Return the Canadian bacon to the pot, covering with a lid.
Transfer the pot to the preheated oven, braising for 2 hours.
Remove the pot from the oven and let cool slightly before serving.
